tools.name: preview_outreach
tools.description: Use when someone wants to know who might buy from a company, who its competitors are, or what a first cold email to a prospect could say. Give it the company website. It reads the public website and returns a preview: what the company sells, competitors, buyer segments, how many companies match, fiv

tools.name: continue_preview
tools.description: Fetch the latest results of a preview_outreach run that returned done: false. Pass the previewId it returned. Read-only for the user: it sends nothing, saves nothing to any account, and changes nothing anywhere.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_outreach · Public sink: preview_outreach · Destructive: continue_preview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_outreach · Public sink: preview_outreach · Destructive: continue_preview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
